candidates.citation: NV CR 25-16 (Washoe Co. — Lake Tahoe and tributaries)

parameters.note: Tunnel Creek flows into Lake Tahoe near Hidden Beach on the east (Nevada) shore in Washoe County, so it is a Lake Tahoe tributary governed by NDOW's Washoe County 'Lake Tahoe and tributaries' listing in CR 25-16: open year-round, except for closed areas. Tunnel Creek is NOT one of the Washoe County closed waters — the CR 25-16 closed-waters list names only Third, Incline, and Wood creeks (each closed from Lake Tahoe up to Mt. Rose Highway) plus the 200-yard radii around the mouths of Third, Incline, and Wood and a 500-yard radius from the Sand Harbor boat ramp; Tunnel Creek and its mouth are omitted, so the general open-year-round tributary season applies to it with no stated upstream distance limit. This is the Nevada rule and differs from the California §7.50(b)(152) seasonal catch-and-release closure that applies to Tahoe tributaries on the California side of the lake.

candidates.summary: Open year-round as a Lake Tahoe tributary; Tunnel Creek is not among the Washoe County closed creeks (Third, Incline, and Wood are).

candidates.citation: NV CR 25-16 (Washoe Co. — Lake Tahoe and tributaries)

parameters.counting_rule: The Washoe County 'Lake Tahoe and tributaries' listing sets 5 game fish daily and 10 in possession, with no species sub-limit. 'Game fish' in Nevada includes trout, mountain whitefish, kokanee salmon, bass, and other listed game species combined.

candidates.summary: 5 game fish daily, 10 in possession (Lake Tahoe and tributaries listing; no species sub-limit)

candidates.citation: NV CR 25-16 (Washoe Co. — Lake Tahoe and tributaries)

parameters.note: The Washoe County 'Lake Tahoe and tributaries' listing restricts fishing hours to 1 hour before sunrise through 2 hours after sunset (unlike most other Washoe waters, which are open any hour of the day or night).

candidates.summary: Fishing hours: 1 hour before sunrise to 2 hours after sunset.

parameters.note: Nevada requires a fishing license for residents and nonresidents 12 years of age or older; anglers under 12 need no license (nonresidents under 12 are limited to 50% of the daily bag). The California/Nevada Lake Tahoe license reciprocity applies to fishing IN Lake Tahoe itself (and the Nevada Interstate Boundary Waters License is valid only on the lake), so it does NOT extend to Tunnel Creek above the lake — a Nevada fishing license is required to fish this tributary.

candidates.summary: Nevada fishing license required for anglers 12+ (lake license reciprocity does not extend to the tributary).
